text:
morgan: Heads up — saw a weird billing spike on sandbox when a streaming request hit quota mid-flight and the router retried to a fallback model. Charges show both partial streams as billable. anyone seen this?
laura: saw the same in logs for req-5a9f. stream was aborted during a toolcall and router issued a retry to the smaller model. billing records show tokens for both streams. looks like dedupe didn't catch it.
sam: repro steps i used:
```bash
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' -H 'Idempotency-Key: req-5a9f' \
  -d '{"stream":true,"model":"rwd-*-large","tools":["search"]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
you can see the server emits a partial stream, then a new stream from fallback.
ali: theory: router creates a new internal request id for the retried generation. billing dedupe only uses the client Idempotency-Key. toolcall callbacks create separate internal sub-requests that the billing service treats as independent if the internal ids differ. edge case: partial stream + toolcall => forked request graph.
laura: is the root cause that we assume streaming==single final accounting event? if we only account at the end, retries create multiple ends.
aj: suggestion: two options — (A) reserve tokens at start based on estimated max and only finalize on end, or (B) introduce provisional vs final billing events: emit provisional at stream start and send final delta at completion. provisional allows console/alerts to show reserved amounts and final reconciles.
morgan: (A) is heavy for small requests — reservations add complexity and wasted reserved quotas. (B) seems viable. we already emit some telemetry events for streams; adding a small billing envelope shouldn't be too invasive.
sam: sample telemetry envelope idea:
```json
{"event":"billing.provisional","req_id":"req-5a9f","reserved_tokens":120,"model":"rwd-xl"}
{"event":"billing.final","req_id":"req-5a9f","used_tokens":87,"refund_tokens":33}
```
billing service would accept provisional and then reconcile final; dedupe uses the req_id across retries if router populates a parent_request_id.
ali: important: router must propagate parent_request_id to retried streams (and toolcall callbacks). currently fallback creates a sibling request without parent metadata. minimal fix: attach `x-parent-req: req-5a9f` to the retry. billing dedupe should prefer parent id when present.
devex: UX: console should show provisional vs actual charges on the request detail page. In Cost Explorer, expose a checkbox for "include provisional reservations" and show reconciled adjustments (refund events). also surfacing a short explanation: "partial streaming + retry -> provisional reserved tokens may be refunded on completion."
laura: agree — and we need a telemetry query for the mismatch: count of provisional events with no final within 5m, and number of final tokens < provisional tokens. add a dashboard panel and alert if > 0.5% of requests show mismatch.
morgan: i'll add unit tests in billing-service for: duplicate provisional->final reconcile, parent_request_id dedupe, toolcall sub-request attribution. also adding an integration test where router does fallback mid-stream.
sam: one more gotcha: existing clients sometimes omit Idempotency-Key for streaming; we can't require it universally. must rely on server-generated request ids and router parent propagation.
aj: implementation plan:
1) billing: accept `billing.provisional` and `billing.final` telemetry, store provisional with TTL 1h. final reconciles and issues credit/refund event if final < provisional.
2) router: propagate `x-parent-req` on retries and toolcall callbacks.
3) console: show provisional/final on request timeline; surface adjustments in cost explorer.
4) signals: add observability query + 1% sample traces to validate path.
devex: note for rollout: flag as `billing.provisional` behind ff, ramp 0 -> 20% -> 100% once reconciles are stable. update docs/sample code for Idempotency-Key usage.
deploy-bot: feature-flag `billing.provisional` toggled ON for eng-platform staging (20%).
morgan: i'll draft a tiny RFC and file in the eng-platform RFCs board; will include migration notes for existing reconciliations and how refunds appear in billing exports.
sam: adding tasks to sprint: billing-service change + router propagation + console UI + tests.
laura: can we also log a short human-readable explanation in the request audit log so SRE/support can explain to customers why they saw provisional charge? "Provisional tokens reserved while streaming; final usage reconciled after completion."
aj: yes, add `billing_note` field to request events.
morgan: thanks all — next steps: aj + sam pair on billing schema, ali + laura on router propagation tests. i'll own dashboard and RFC.
sam: sounds good. i'll update this thread when i push a PR. :thumbsup:
laura: thx!
